name: inprocess-obi-axi4lite-ibex-zipcpu-axiluart-f1f4
notes: the target is the pinned ZipCPU axiluart AXI4-Lite slave (C_AXI_ADDR_WIDTH=4, window 16 bytes); SETUP is at offset 0
axiluart.v:345 stores new_setup[30:0] after applying WSTRB, and axiluart.v:664 returns {1'b0, uart_setup}, so write_mask and read_mask are 0x7fffffff and bit 31 is never stored or returned
rx=1 and cts_n=0 are the pin constants the phase-one descriptor declared for the same slave; the entry drives them from the generated model's own input rows
both declared clocks are 50 MHz (configs/cpus/ibex_rvfi_local, configs/peripherals/zipcpu_axiluart), so no equal-period assumption is needed
F5 (IRQ delivery) and F6 (DMA) are not wired by this entry and are refused by name
